note: Behaviour profiles for the mock backend's model tiers. The mock stands in for models of different strength, so the tiers must differ in quality as well as price — otherwise routing cannot be measured at all. These degradations are SIMULATED, chosen to mimic failure modes small models actually have, and are deliberately of a kind the confidence signals can detect: that is what makes escalation fire on the documents that need it.

mock-extractor-small-v1.note: Truncates long item tables and does not repair split small-caps runs or derive a missing total. The truncation breaks the sum-to-subtotal rule, which is exactly how a reviewer (or the router) notices.
